# SpikeTiming_Dependent_Plasticity_OnChip

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An on-chip learning rule that adjusts memristor conductances based on the relative timing of pre- and post-synaptic spikes, implemented directly in the accelerator. Allows in-network adaptation without external training, critical for real-time interception in dynamic environments.
